intent: PSI-065: google-calendar /sync (pull) — pull Google Calendar events via cron, mirror to public.events with role/group audience, loop prevention, and prune.
summary: Implemented supabase/functions/google-calendar/index.ts and mapper.ts for the 15-minute cron pull sync. Added supabase/functions/_shared/google.ts for RS256 JWT service account token generation and _shared/internal.ts for bearer authentication. Handles singleEvents recurrence expansion, all-day conversion (+07:00), cancellation filtering, loop prevention via p3md_event_id check, upsert_google_event RPC, and prune_google_events RPC. Added Bun unit tests (6/6 pass) and expanded pgTAP tests in supabase/tests/google.test.sql (13/13 pass, 64 total across suite).

changes.note: Service account RS256 JWT token signer and gfetch helper
Google Calendar event mapping and loop prevention filter
Edge function for /sync pull cron and /push routing
Unit tests for mapper, recurrence, all-day and filters
pgTAP assertions for upsert_google_event and RLS audience visibility

decisions.decision: Extract pure event mapper into mapper.ts
decisions.reason: Allows fast Bun unit tests without requiring Deno npm: import specifier shims.
Prevents sync loops where events pushed by our app get re-imported as new Google events.

decisions.decision: Map all-day event start dates to 00:00:00+07:00 (Asia/Jakarta)
decisions.reason: Aligns with the application standard timezone specification for agenda displays.
